title: 第203章 朔阳地界长生教残党第202章 卑职一个副统领怎么敢有异议
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 陆渊一把抓去，将那颗血肉模糊的脑袋提起，又重重砸下。
砰！
“州司不会放过我？那你得先去州司再说。”
“你敢去青州吗？”
郑恪躺在坑底，浑身骨骼无处不疼。
他敢去青州吗？
不敢。
他比谁都清楚，就算真去了青州，这事他也不占理。
更何况，谁会为了一个朔阳驻所的副统领去触血衣阎君的霉头？
“说话！”
陆渊神色如常，嗓音中听不出喜怒。
随着五指发力，剧烈的疼痛袭上郑恪心头，他整个人瞬间被莫大的恐惧席卷。
他怕了。
再不求饶，他真的会死。
“饶了我！”
郑恪的心神终于崩溃。
他被陆渊扣住面门，连挣扎都做不到。
鲜血从脸上淌下来，他口中哀嚎不止，哪里还顾得上平日里最看重的体面。
“卑职错了！是卑职不知天高地厚！求陆大人饶命！”
陆渊松开手，神色平静地看着他。
郑恪心头猛地一紧，他读懂了那个眼神。
他下意识左右环顾，清晰地看到在场所有人都在看着自己。
江不尘抄着手，半眯着眼。
乔山手按刀柄，面无表情。
还有那些镇魔卫，正用复杂而震撼的眼神看着他。
昔日威严的副统领此刻倒地岂降，像一条被踩住尾巴的丧家之犬。
郑恪的心脏猛地收紧，绝望之感涌上心头，无边屈辱几乎将他吞没。
他宁可陆渊再给他一拳，把他打昏过去，也不愿在这般沉默的注视下跪着求饶。
可陆渊没有动手，只是站在那里，一脸平静地看着他，等着他自己做出选择。
郑恪此时几近崩溃，在这样的压力下，他终于彻底丧失了最后一丝抵抗的意志。
他艰难地翻过身，浑身颤抖着伏在地上，规矩地跪在陆渊脚下。
“陆大人……卑职再也不敢了……真的……求您……求您饶了卑职！”
陆渊没再说话，起身扫视四周，众人皆是一言不发。
李辅走到坑边，叹了口气，堂堂副统领的体面此刻已是碎得渣都不剩。
敢对陆渊不敬，以下犯上？
这不是纯纯找打吗？
至于帮郑恪说说话……李辅刚才拦了，也喝止了，可郑恪不领情。
不然的话，也不会沦落到现在这个下场。
李辅收回目光，扫了一眼四周。
玄清观弟子都在墓道里挖墓，孟守静死了，曹衍、周元青重伤。
他转向陆渊，压低声音道：“陆大人，曹衍和周元青，您打算怎么处置？”
“押回驻所与冯端一并收监候审。”
陆渊语气淡然道：“至于那些挖墓的弟子，等散煞阵布好，墓道清理完毕，放他们回观。”
content_en:
Lu Yuan grabbed it, lifted the bloody head, and slammed it down again.
Bang!
"The governor won't let me go? Then you have to go to the governor first."
"Do you dare to go to Qingzhou?"
Zheng Ke lay at the bottom of the pit, feeling pain everywhere in his body.
Does he dare to go to Qingzhou?
Don't dare.
He knew better than anyone that even if he really went to Qingzhou, he would not be responsible for the matter.
What's more, who would go to the trouble of Xueyi Yanjun for the sake of a deputy commander in Shuoyang?
"Speak!"
Lu Yuan's expression was as usual, and there was no emotion or anger in his voice.
As his five fingers exerted force, severe pain hit Zheng Ke's heart, and his whole body was instantly swept by great fear.
He was afraid.
If he doesn't beg for mercy, he will really die.
"Spare me!"
Zheng Ke's mind finally collapsed.
He was held face to face by Lu Yuan and couldn't even struggle.
Blood dripped from his face, and he kept wailing in his mouth, unable to care about the dignity he valued most.
"The humble position is wrong! It's the humble position that doesn't know the heights of the world! Please spare my life, Mr. Lu!"
Lu Yuan let go of his hand and looked at him calmly.
Zheng Ke's heart suddenly tightened as he understood that look.
He subconsciously looked around and clearly saw everyone present looking at him.
Jiang Buchen folded his hands and half-squinted his eyes.
Qiao Shan pressed the handle of the knife with his hand, his face expressionless.
There were also those demon-suppressing guards who were looking at him with complex and shocking eyes.
The former majestic deputy commander now fell to the ground, like a lost dog whose tail was stepped on.
Zheng Ke's heart tightened suddenly, a feeling of despair surged into his heart, and boundless humiliation almost swallowed him up.
He would rather Lu Yuan punch him again and knock him unconscious than kneel down and beg for mercy under such silent gaze.
But Lu Yuan didn't do anything, he just stood there, looking at him calmly, waiting for him to make his own choice.
Zheng Ke almost collapsed at this time. Under such pressure, he finally completely lost his last vestige of will to resist.
He turned over with difficulty, trembling on the ground, and knelt at Lu Yuan's feet.
"Master Lu...I don't dare to be humble anymore...really...please...please spare my humble position!"
Lu Yuan said no more. He stood up and looked around. Everyone was silent.
Li Fu walked to the edge of the pit and sighed. The dignity of the dignified deputy commander was now in pieces.
If you dare to be disrespectful to Lu Yuan, what's the next offense?
Isn't this just looking for a fight?
As for helping Zheng Ke to speak... Li Fu stopped him just now and stopped drinking, but Zheng Ke didn't appreciate it.
Otherwise, he would not have fallen to this end.
Li Fu withdrew his gaze and glanced around.
All the disciples of Xuanqingguan were digging graves in the tomb passage. Meng Shoujing died, and Cao Yan and Zhou Yuanqing were seriously injured.
He turned to Lu Yuan and lowered his voice: "Master Lu, what do you plan to do with Cao Yan and Zhou Yuanqing?"
"Take him back to the station and put him in jail together with Feng Duan pending trial."
Lu Yuan said in a calm tone: "As for the disciples who dug the tomb, let them go back and watch after the evil formation is set up and the tomb passage is cleared."
title_en: Chapter 203 The remnants of the Immortality Cult in Shuoyang Realm Chapter 202 How dare a deputy commander in a humble position have any objections
